title: Review equipment and technician capacity
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Give me the equipment and technician-capacity picture I should review before the weekly maintenance meeting.

answer.question: Give me the equipment and technician-capacity picture I should review before the weekly maintenance meeting.
answer.answer:
Here's the picture for your weekly meeting:

**Equipment**
- Line 3: Machine #7 is in **yellow alert** — preventive maintenance required. Machines #5, #6, #8 all running normal.
- Line 2: Machine #9 standby (normal), Machine #12 on **watch/monitor** status — worth a look.
- Line 1 (Machine #3, conveyor) and Chiller #2 all normal.

**Technician Capacity**
- Only **Team B** (Marcus Chen – lead, IM-2000 specialist; Sarah Park – Level 3) is available Saturday.
- Team A (Marcus Rivera) and Team C (Lin Zhao) are **not available** this weekend.

**Takeaway:** Machine #7 is the priority item, and Team B is your only Saturday coverage — worth flagging if more than one job needs attention. Want me to pull the predictive alert details or a proposed work order window for #7?
